component_I_usage._comment: Component-I Farkas trees used by the paper (Sections 7-8, Appendix A). Paths are relative to component_I/ (the root of the October 26 archive, which contains verify_end_to_end.py). The sha256 values are pinned from the archive's replay report of 2026-10-29 (component_I_reference_replay_2026-10-29.json); make_manifest.py and verify_release.py refuse a component I whose used trees differ. Node counts are those stated in the paper; each was confirmed by counting the tree files themselves (25 trees, 23,753 nodes, 11,889 leaves).

used.case: (1,2) ternary regions (14 trees; L=2, L1_outer, L1_A_low, L1_A_high, L3_low (4), L3_high)
